contextReview.basis: Direct review: clear, sunny daytime East Asian urban shopping streets with small tiled building walls, shop windows, canvas awnings, potted plants, parked scooters and brick or stone paving; hard direct sun with sharp shadows and a visible sheen of sweat on skin. No rain is depicted, and a small damp patch on the paving is not read as rain. Humid is the producer's hot-humid styling setting, not a measurement. Mixed adult model casting is independent of the location.

casting.castingPolicy: mixed adult model appearance independent of the East Asian urban location (user 2026-11-03)

approval.evidence: Five editorials passed producer QA and continued under the user's standing workflow authorization (2026-11-03, "앞으로도 승인 없이 진행"); the user did not visually approve them individually. Product images passed producer technical QA and producer visual QA on four backgrounds only.

reconstructionNotice: The receipt stuck to the raised sole is a scene prop, not a product. The woman bends and raises one foot, so the tee's back, the skirt's hidden side and the full length of its slit are conservatively reconstructed. The navy tote is seen from the side and partly hidden by the arm; its front and second handle are inferred. The watch is seen at an angle, with its hidden strap inferred. Both sneakers and both socks are visible and listed as one pair each. Brand, fibre composition, metal, performance and retail identity are unknown.

findings: All five overview sheets reviewed. Blue shirt shows no visible stray edge flecks in the final composites.
